name: Employment Kirklees
organisation: Paddock Community Trust, in partnership with Kirklees Council
whoFor: Anyone living in Kirklees, in or out of work, looking for employment support close to home.
locations: Paddock Trust bases in Huddersfield and Batley
Community settings across Kirklees - libraries, community and faith centres, schools and other accessible public venues
eligibility: Lives in Kirklees, whether employed or unemployed
Looking for support into work, apprenticeships, in-work progression or self-employment, or looking for new skills, learning or training
referralRoutes: Online enquiry and registration on My Kirklees ('Make an enquiry to Employment and Skills Support'): https://my.kirklees.gov.uk/service/Jobs_and_training___Make_an_enquiry_to_Employment_and_Skills_Support
Online enquiry via the Paddock Trust website
In person - via community venues and drop-ins
Partner referral, including Kirklees Council Employment & Skills Service

projects.name: One-to-one employment support
projects.overview: Starts with an assessment of the person's situation, skills and goals. Covers strengths and transferable skills, CVs, job applications and interviews, benefits and financial advice, and volunteering, training and education opportunities. Helps with barriers such as childcare, low confidence or lack of skills.
projects.duration: Flexible and open-ended, at the person's own pace

projects.name: Group workshops
projects.overview: Course-based workshops in community settings on personal development, wellbeing, goal setting, CV writing, job searching and interview techniques, alongside 1-to-1 guidance.

projects.name: Connecting to local opportunities and services
projects.overview: Links people to local employers, vacancies, training providers and wider community support, including digital inclusion, information and advice, and wellbeing services delivered by Paddock Trust.

workExperience: Volunteering and work-related opportunities identified as part of the plan
notes: Status before November 2026: Live - open to referrals

provenance.source: Kirklees HWL Pathways Aug 26 v2.1 (draft 15 Sept 2026; grant-funded schemes added 12 Oct 2026); registration link from the Employment Kirklees flyer (Word document, 11 Oct 2026)
